Title: Public preview: Platform-supported migration of IaaS resources

Body.Content:
We're excited to announce the public preview of a new service for platform-supported migration of IaaS resources from the classic to the Azure Resource Manager stack. This service allows you to migrate your IaaS virtual machines (VMs) and network resources through a step-by-step-workflow from the classic to the Resource Manager stack. The two scopes that we're offering with this preview are migrating "VMs not in a virtual network" and a "virtual network along with all the VMs." This migration service is now available in all regions where virtual machines are available, and there is no additional cost. 

To learn more about how to get started, see the platform-supported migration documentation.
